questions.question: Amar bought a TV for Rs. 16,500/- and sold it at 20% profit. What is his selling price (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
CP of the T.V = Rs. 16500

SP of the T.V = 16500 × (120/100) = Rs. 19,900

questions.question:
Evaluate the following expression.

(64 × 7) + (8 ÷ 2) – 6 × 8
questions.solution:
Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order given below:

Step-1: Parts of an equation enclosed in 'Brackets' must be solved first, and in the bracket,

Step-2: Any mathematical 'Of' or 'Exponent' must be solved next,

Step-3: Next, the parts of the equation that contain 'Division' and 'Multiplication' are calculated,

Step-4: Last but not least, the parts of the equation that contain 'Addition' and 'Subtraction' should be calculated.

(64 × 7) + (8 ÷ 2) – 6 × 8

⇒ 448 + 4 – 48

⇒ 452 – 48

⇒ 404

questions.question: If LCM and HCF of the two numbers are given by 1105 and 5 respectively. One of the numbers is 65. Find the second number.
questions.solution:
Let the second number be x.

As we know, Product of two numbers = HCF × LCF

⇒ 65 × x = 1105 × 5

⇒ x = 85

questions.question: Mani had a pizza cut into 16 equal parts, if he ate 14 pieces and he gave two pieces to his friend, what fraction of the pizza did his friend ate?
questions.solution:
Total pieces of pizza = 16

⇒ Pizza pieces eaten by his friend = 2

⇒ Required fraction = 2/16 = 1/8

Teacher gave 20 problems as homework for Lata, she did all the even numbered questions that were divisible by 4 and left out the rest, what fraction of question remained unanswered by Lata?
questions.solution:
Total problems given by teacher = 20

Total number divisible by 4 are = 4, 8, 12, 16, 20

Now, we can say that total number divisible by 4 are 5.

Remaining number which not divisible by 4 = 20 – 5 = 15

⇒ Required fraction = 15/20 = 3/4

questions.question: Identify the smallest number exactly divisible by 12, 18, 72 and 256.
Find the least value of x for which the number 82178342x52 is divisible by 3.
questions.solution:
As we know,

Divisibility of 3 ⇒ A number divisible by 3 if the sum of its digit divisible by 3.

Sum of digits of 82178342x52

⇒ 8 + 2 + 1 + 7 + 8 + 3 + 4 + 2 + x + 5 + 2

⇒ 42 + x

∵ 42 is divisible by 3, the least value of x is 0 so that the given number will be divisible by 3.

questions.question: Find the value of 0.129129129…..
A physician gives 2/3rd of tablet 1 and 1/4th of another tablet 2 to be taken twice a day for 3 consecutive days. After the 2ⁿd day how many parts of tablets of 1 and 2 the patient would have taken?

options.text: tablet 1 : one whole tablet and tablet 2:2(2)/(3) parts
tablet 1:1(2)/(3) parts and tablet 2 : one whole tablet
tablet 1 : one whole tablet and tablet 2:1(2)/(3) parts
tablet 1:2(2)/(3) parts and tablet 2 : one whole tablet

questions.solution:
Part of tablet 1 given by the physician to patient in one time = 2/3rd

Total parts of tablets 1 taken by patient in two days = 2/3rd × 2 × 2 = 8/3 = 2(2)/(3) parts

Part of tablet 2 given by the physician to patient in one time = 1/4th

Total parts of tablet 2 taken by patient in two days = 1/4th × 2 × 2 = 1

questions.question: Find the compound interest (in Rs.) on Rs. 25,000 for 2 years at 6% per annum, the interest being compounded half yearly.
questions.solution:
As we know,

⇒ A = P [1 + (r/100)]t

∵ The interest being compounded half yearly,

⇒ r = 6/2 = 3% and t = 2 × 2 = 4

⇒ A = 25000 × (103/100) × (103/100) × (103/100) × (103/100) = Rs. 28137.7

Compound interest = A – P = 28137.7 – 25000 = Rs. 3137.7

questions.question: Find the volume of a hemisphere with the radius of 3 cm.
questions.solution:
Radius of hemisphere = 3 cm

Volume of hemisphere = 2/3 × π × r³ = 2/3 × 22/7 × 3 × 3 × 3 = 56.57 cm³

questions.question: Amar purchased a bag for Rs. 600/- and sold it for Rs. 540/-. What is his loss percentage?
questions.solution:
CP of the bag = Rs. 600

Sp of the bag = Rs. 540

Loss = 600 – 540 = Rs. 60

⇒ Required loss percentage = (60/600) × 100 = 10%

questions.solution:

questions.question: A sum becomes Rs. 108 at 4% simple interest rate in 2 years. Find the sum.
questions.solution:
Let principal be Rs. x.

⇒ SI = (P × R × T)/100

Given Rate = 4%, Time = 2 years, Amount = 108 and SI = (108 – x)

⇒ (108 – x) = (x × 4 × 2)/100

⇒ 10800 – 100x = 8x

⇒ x = 100

questions.question: Ankit purchased a printer for Rs. 15,600/- and sold at Rs. 17,160/-. What is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
⇒ SP of a printer = 15600

⇒ CP of the printer = 17160

∴ Required profit percentage = [(17160 – 15600)/15600] × 100 = 10%

If P/15 = Q/21 = R/7 then find the ratio P : Q : R.
questions.solution:
⇒ P/15 = Q/21 = R/7

Suppose P/15 = Q/21 = R/7 = k

⇒ P = 15k, Q = 21k and R = 7k

∴ Required ratio = P : Q : R

⇒ 15k : 21k : 7k

⇒ 15 : 21 : 7

questions.question: Find the greatest possible length which can be used to measure 2 m, 75 cm, and 8 m, 65 cm.
questions.solution:
As we know, 1 m = 100 cm

⇒ 2 m 75 cm = 275 cm = 5 × 5 × 11

⇒ 8 m 65 cm = 865 cm = 5 × 173

∴ H.C.F of 2 m 75 cm and 8m 65 cm is 5.

questions.question: Express the speed of 18 m/s in km/h.
questions.solution:
As we know, 1 km/h = 5/18 m/sec

⇒ 1 m/s = 18/5 km/h

⇒ 18 m/s = 18 × (18/5) km/h = 64.8 km/hr
